environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with the application connecting as a superuser role (rds_superuser). No RLS policies are defined on the tenant_records table. The JWT_SECRET environment variable is set to the base64-decoded content of the RSA public key file (a common misconfiguration where the HMAC secret equals the public key bytes). Network access is direct to the service on port 8080 with no reverse proxy.
